name: Raptor: Call of the Shadows
description:
Raptor: Call of the Shadows (Source Port) is a reverse-engineered native PC port of the classic 1994 vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up by Cygnus Studios and Apogee Software. It lets players pilot the futuristic mercenary fighter natively on Linux.

Features:
- Native execution on modern 64-bit operating systems with fluid high framerates
- High-resolution graphics scaling with support for modern widescreen displays
- Full support for modern gamepads, flight sticks, mice, and keyboards
- Faithful reproduction of all original sectors (Bravo, Tango, Outer Regions)
- High-quality audio output restoring the original digital sound effects and MIDI tracks
